checks.title: Appropriate sample weight

checks.title: Analytic weights positive and non-missing
checks.message: 0 analytic records with missing/zero weight. Weighted population represented: 155.1 million.

checks.title: Design degrees of freedom
checks.message: Analytic population spans 31 PSUs in 14 strata (df = 17). NCHS flags estimates with df < 8.

checks.title: Analytic sample size
checks.message: Analytic n = 3,029.

checks.title: Events per model parameter
checks.message: 134 events, 2649 non-events, 13 parameters -> 10.3 per parameter (rule of thumb >= 10).

checks.title: Outcome missingness
checks.message: 0.2% of the eligible population lacks the outcome (8 of 4588). Missing outcome is assumed missing at random within the design.

checks.title: Complete-case loss
checks.message: 8.1% of the analytic sample (246) lack >=1 covariate.

checks.title: Raw values within plausible ranges
checks.message: Out-of-range values: LBXSCR (1 low, 0 high); URDACT (0 low, 3 high)

checks.title: NCHS presentation standards for proportions
checks.message: 20 of 34 estimates meet the standard; 3 should be suppressed, 11 flagged for review.

checks.title: Models converged without warnings
checks.message: 3 models converged cleanly.

checks.title: No implausible effect sizes
checks.message: All ratio estimates within 0.1-10 with SE(log) < 2.5.

checks.title: Model size vs design degrees of freedom
checks.message: Primary model has 14 parameters; design df = 17. Wald tests and CIs use the design df (t distribution).

checks.title: Collinearity (generalized VIF)
checks.message: Maximum VIF 2.54 (race_ethNon-Hispanic White).

checks.title: Sensitivity analyses agree with primary result
checks.message: 4 of 4 sensitivity analyses agree in direction (associations) or magnitude (prevalence).

checks.title: Age top-coding
checks.message: NHANES top-codes age at 80 years; age is modelled as continuous with this censoring.
